events.title: Watch Our Recorded Playtest
events.summary: During Steam Next Fest, we're streaming a playtest session on our store page. *This is pre-recorded footage, not a live stream. Japanese voice chat with English subtitles. Stack & Sus is a social deduction game for 3–6 players where everyone stacks one burger together. The Staff try to complete the burger, while the hidden Spy secretly sabotages it. Each game takes about 10 minutes. The free demo is available now, and the full game is coming soon. Add it to your wishlist!
